en.longDescription:
AFFiNE is an open-source all-in-one workspace for docs, whiteboards, and knowledge management.

Includes PostgreSQL (pgvector), Redis, and a one-shot migration job. Set AFFINE_SERVER_EXTERNAL_URL via SERVICE_URL_AFFINE. Create the first admin account on first launch.

de.longDescription:
AFFiNE ist ein Open-Source-All-in-One-Workspace für Dokumente, Whiteboards und Wissensmanagement.

Enthält PostgreSQL (pgvector), Redis und einen einmaligen Migrations-Job. Setze AFFINE_SERVER_EXTERNAL_URL über SERVICE_URL_AFFINE. Erstelle beim ersten Start das erste Admin-Konto.

fr.shortDescription: Base de connaissances et espace de travail open source
fr.longDescription:
AFFiNE est un espace de travail tout-en-un open source pour les documents, les tableaux blancs et la gestion des connaissances.

Inclut PostgreSQL (pgvector), Redis et un job de migration unique. Définissez AFFINE_SERVER_EXTERNAL_URL via SERVICE_URL_AFFINE. Créez le premier compte administrateur au premier lancement.

pt.shortDescription: Base de conhecimento e workspace open-source
pt.longDescription:
AFFiNE é um workspace tudo-em-um open-source para documentos, quadros brancos e gestão de conhecimento.

Inclui PostgreSQL (pgvector), Redis e um job de migração único. Defina AFFINE_SERVER_EXTERNAL_URL via SERVICE_URL_AFFINE. Crie a primeira conta de administrador no primeiro acesso.
